stage_names.source: MOZ stage-name strips drawn in the WO1 PC stage-name face, harvested from WO1 506.15 (font, rows in atlas order). names follow MOZ strip order: WO2 PS2 USA stage names (menu member 17 files 13-14), WO1 PC 506.15 names, then MOZ-only stages (authored, with their Japanese). Each strips range takes the first count names. Strips are enlarged to 512 texels so the longest name (428) keeps the face's native size; the exe draws them 440 wide. Authored at native size: x is X with its four arms slid along their own diagonals to the x-height.
